title: Chapter 434: The Shocking Battle Of Shenwu City
content:
Chapter 434: The Shocking Battle Of Shenwu City

The capital of the Shenwu Empire - Shenwu City.

The second prince Min Lie stood on the gate tower, looking at the dark and endless army under the city, his face heavy.

He did not expect that his third and seventh brothers could get so many responses.

The situation at this moment is obviously out of control.

When he conspired to kill his eldest brother, he was also bewitched by his subordinates. When the matter was exposed, he was already riding a tiger and it was difficult to get off.

For the throne, he could only be hard-hearted.

There are many empires of all sizes around the Shenwu Empire.

But these empires, in name, are all under the jurisdiction of the Shenwu Empire.

They habitually divide these empires into four levels.

Under the Shenwu Empire, there are 4 first-level empires, 8 second-level empires, 16 third-level empires, and 32 fourth-level empires.

A total of 60 empires.

All other forces are considered inferior.

The level and strength of an empire are usually divided by the number of troops, the size of the territory, and the number of top powerhouses.

To reach the fourth-level empire, there must be at least one strongest king in the empire.

To become the third level, at least two are needed.

And so on, otherwise it will not be able to suppress the empire below.

The Shenwu Empire undoubtedly has the most strongest kings, with more than 100 people at its peak.

They all obey the Supreme Saint Emperor of the Shenwu Empire and control the tens of thousands of miles of territory of the Shenwu Empire.

But as soon as the old emperor died, the strongest kings chose their favorite princes.

There are even more people who do not want to be involved in this dispute and began to choose to stay out of the world and live in seclusion.

Suddenly, the soldiers outside the city began to attack, and the huge catapult threw shells.

Compared with this giant catapult, the catapult in Wang Shuo's territory is as fragile as a toy.

The shells fell on the light curtain above the city, like gorgeous fireworks.

But the light curtain did not move at all.

The second prince on the city wall had no time to be happy.

Then he found that shells like this were pouring down on the light curtain like a rain of shells.

This was a scene he had never seen in his life.

"Boom boom..."

The ear-piercing explosions lasted for a whole day, and the light curtain on the city wall finally couldn't hold up.

"Attack."

The second prince finally panicked.

The troops outside the city were several times more than his, and the city wall couldn't defend against those masters at all.

The strongest kings flew up the city wall one after another.

"Old Weird Liu, I think you should surrender!" An old man smiled at an old man named Liu next to the second prince.

"Bullshit, you treacherous people. I will never let you succeed."

"It's as if the second prince is the orthodox. Speaking of it, he should be the one who killed his brother and sought the throne!"

The two strong men had a few words of verbal battle, but they were not satisfied and started fighting directly.

Strong men kept choosing their opponents, and for a while, the walls were full of the aftermath of various earth-shattering moves.

The walls that lost the protection of the rune formation were soon broken.

The forces of the third and seventh princes poured into the imperial city.

This battle was actually far more than just three princes fighting for the throne.

Under the secret instigation of the four first-level empires, the battle was completely out of control.

Even the original planners did not expect.

A battle of this scale would break out.

Just like gamblers at the gambling table, once they place a bet, they can only keep raising the bet. In the end, their own forces sent dozens of the strongest king-level masters to participate in this battle.

The battle lasted for three days.

The entire Shenwu City was destroyed.
